storyCards.headline: Let Your Love Flow: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
The Bellamy Brothers's "Let Your Love Flow" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 19 weeks on the chart.

Let Your Love Flow was released in 1976.

"Let Your Love Flow" by The Bellamy Brothers.

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
